goal: Every held-out landing-gate evaluation (pass, fail, or no-gate) appends a ledger record carrying each executed grader's name, outcome, and bounded output tail, so a gate-decided park is diagnosable from the store alone.

graders.name: lint
graders.run: uv run ruff check packages/flywheel-core packages/flywheel-orchestrator

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_held_out_gate.py -- GateVerdict and the in-memory grader receipts that must be persisted

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- _evaluate_landing_gate / _record_held_out_gate_park emit sites; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols instead of whole-file reads
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- domain-event vocabulary gains the verdict record
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/event_serde.py -- serde for the new kind, updated in this same change
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_events.py -- extend with round-trip coverage for the new kind
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_workflow.py -- status park surfacing must stay green
references: docs/held-out-gate.md -- current behavior: verdict lives on RunRecord only, receipts are dropped
constraints: Record every evaluation including no-gate (spec D-1); pass and fail records carry per-grader receipts
The output excerpt is a tail capped at 8192 bytes per grader, stored raw; redaction is applied at render time, not persist time (spec D-2, criterion 10)
flywheel_core.task and flywheel_core.lifecycle stay pure; follow the existing events.py / event_serde.py pattern
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not change gate decision semantics -- what passes, blocks, or fails closed is untouched
Do not add CLI rendering; the retrieval surfaces are later tasks
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A verdict record with an empty output excerpt must fail the behavior test -- assert on real oracle output content, not record presence
A no-gate evaluation leaves a record distinguishable from no record at all
A grader emitting more than the bound persists a truncated excerpt that retains the final content (criterion 11)
